claim.notes: CFR+ with 10000 iterations on the full game tree; exploitability computed exactly by best responses over the full tree; sum of probabilities per information set is 1 up to float rounding. Exploitability is still decreasing (about 1/sqrt(T)), so this is not converged to a tight tolerance; more iterations would reduce it. Value -0.0857 matches the published Leduc value of about -0.0856.
